what: Victoria's Secret sells lingerie, loungewear and beauty products under Victoria's Secret, PINK and Adore Me, through about 1,350 stores and online.
customers: Women buying lingerie and beauty products, in North America and through international partners.
moat: A brand almost every American woman knows, with mall locations and a beauty business that brings people in more often than lingerie alone would.
risks: Revenue has been roughly flat at $6.2B for several years after the brand's repositioning
A 2.5% net margin leaves little room
Younger competitors have taken share and the mall channel keeps shrinking
opportunities: 13.9 times free cash flow with $554M of free cash flow
Revenue grew to $6.6B last year, the first real growth in years
Analysts see about 6% upside, and the beauty business grows faster than apparel at better margins
watch: Comparable sales and whether the brand repositioning holds.
